mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS avg, COUNT(1) AS total FROM pms_goods_comment WHERE spu_id = #{spuId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0

SELECT c.id, c.spu_id, c.sku_id, c.order_id, c.order_no, c.member_id, c.member_name, c.member_avatar, c.rating, c.content, c.is_anonymous, c.is_replied, c.reply_content, c.reply_time, c.status, c.create_time, c.images, s.name AS spu_name, sk.name AS sku_name FROM pms_goods_comment c LEFT JOIN pms_spu s ON c.spu_id = s.id LEFT JOIN pms_sku sk ON c.sku_id = sk.id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.spu_id, c.sku_id, c.order_id, c.order_no, c.member_id, c.member_name, c.member_avatar, c.rating, c.content, c.is_anonymous, c.is_replied, c.reply_content, c.reply_time, c.status, c.create_time, c.images, sk.name AS sku_name FROM pms_goods_comment c LEFT JOIN pms_sku sk ON c.sku_id = sk.id WHERE c.spu_id = #{spuId} AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0
AND c.rating = #{rating}
AND c.images IS NOT NULL AND c.images != '' AND c.images != '[]'
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
